w:r.w:t: SCC-3385 | Create Work Order for Tickets
Great Plains Merge to UAT | Source retrieval and check-only readiness assessment
No records, deployment, activation, or org metadata were changed

Do not promote SCC-3385. UAT lacks the Trouble Ticket foundation, the source Order exception is incomplete, WorkOrder layouts omit the new fields, and the check-only package failed 8 of 14 components.
Source layout contains Create Work Order; UAT has no Trouble Ticket record type, so visibility cannot validate.
Flow maps Account, address, service, report, notes, and priority; target dependencies and WorkOrder layout fields are missing.
Flow requires Work Type and Work Instructions. UAT has all four named trouble Work Types.
Flow checks CaseId and links the existing Work Order; Source_Case_Id__c is unique. Runtime is untested.
Flow creates a completed Task with Work Order number and Work Type. Runtime is untested.
FSL__Book_Appointment remains on the FSL layout; no runtime regression was executed.
The source implementation is visible, but the promotion path breaks on prerequisite metadata, broad profile drift, and unresolved source design defects.

the Flow design covers gating, required inputs, duplicate detection, value mapping, and activity logging, but deployment and runtime acceptance remain blocked until the foundation and source defects are repaired.
Trouble Ticket record type plus Priority, Service Address, Service Type, Subscriber Report, and Work Order Case fields.
Make Order__c optional and add the active exception validation rule for non-Trouble Ticket Work Orders.
Place all five new fields on both WorkOrder layouts and retain Book Appointment.
Use a focused permission set or filtered profiles; remove ArchiveArticles and unrelated record-type drift.
Create or identify Cases 00001082/00001083 equivalents with exact Account, address, service, report, priority, and notes.
Require a clean 15/15 check-only result, then execute all six tests with IDs and screenshots.

Architect dry run completed for SCC-3385 using GreatPlainsMerge as source and GreatPlainsUAT as the check-only target. Changes Requested / NO-GO: job 0AfEa00000bbQXhKAM was check-only and failed with 8 of 14 components; no metadata or records were changed. UAT is missing the Trouble Ticket record type and the SCC-3384 Case fields used by the Flow. In source, WorkOrder.Order__c remains required, the listed exception validation rule does not exist, and neither WorkOrder layout contains the five new fields. The Flow otherwise includes the record-type guard, required Work Type and Work Instructions, duplicate lookup/link, Case value mapping, completed Task logging, and the FSL Book Appointment action remains present. Complete the six approval gates above, prepare valid test Cases, and require a clean 15-of-15 validation plus all six UAT tests before promotion.

This assessment combines source metadata retrieval, local structural review, read-only org queries, and a GreatPlainsUAT check-only deployment. No records, deployment, activation, quick deploy, or org metadata changes were performed.
